title: Derived scalar-extension/pullback comparison agrees with the ambient strict-diagram tensor map
statement:
Let $u:\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal X)\to\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal Y)$ be a geometric morphism between topoi presented by sites small in the module universe, let $A$ be a commutative ring and let $J$ be a small category [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $B_Y:J\to\operatorname{CAlg}(\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal Y))$ be a diagram of commutative algebras over the constant sheaf $\underline A_Y$, and set $B_X=u^{-1}B_Y$, with the induced algebra structures and all actual diagram transitions. Use the small diagram sites of [lem-weil-pbc-diagram-site-realization], module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], constant ring sheaves [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], and ordinary unbounded derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Write $D_A^J(T)$ for the derived category of $J$-diagrams of $\underline A_T$-modules and $D_B(T)$ for the derived category of semilinear $B_T$-module diagrams. Let $U_T:D_B(T)\to D_A^J(T)$ be exact restriction of scalars [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars], and let $G_A\dashv P_A$, $G_B\dashv P_B$ be the canonical derived diagram inverse-image/direct-image adjunctions. The structural coefficient maps for $u$ are isomorphisms, so $G_A,G_B$ are exact inverse images.
Put $\Sigma_T(M)=M\otimes^L_{\Delta\underline A_T}B_T$, [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings], with scalar-extension unit $i_{T,M}:M\to U_T\Sigma_TM$. Use the derived tensor and pullback models of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback]. There are canonical natural isomorphisms
$$b:G_AU_Y\xrightarrow{\sim}U_XG_B,\qquad c:G_B\Sigma_Y\xrightarrow{\sim}\Sigma_XG_A.$$
Here $b$ is localization of the scalar-unit map $x\mapsto1\otimes x$, whose inverse is multiplication under $u^{-1}B_Y=B_X$. The comparison $c$ is localization of balanced scalar association on flat-term K-flat representatives [lem-pur-cochain-pullback-tensor-coherence], rather than an independently chosen comparison of abstract derived functors. Let
$$\theta_M:G_A(U_Y\Sigma_YM)\xrightarrow{\sim}U_X\Sigma_XG_AM$$
be the ambient pullback/tensor comparison, followed by $G_AB_Y\cong B_X$. Then the following are equalities in the derived category of entire strict diagrams:
$$U_X(c_M)\,b_{\Sigma_YM}=\theta_M,\qquad \theta_M G_A(i_{Y,M})=i_{X,G_AM}.$$
They are natural in $M$ and compatible with compatible maps of the algebra diagrams; on representatives they retain the actual semilinear transitions. No boundedness, flatness of $\underline A_T\to B_{T,j}$, perfectness, quotient or completeness hypothesis is imposed.

theorem algebraDiagramPullbackExtensionCoherence
    (I X Y : Type u) [SmallCategory I] [SmallCategory X] [SmallCategory Y]
    (KX : GrothendieckTopology X) (KY : GrothendieckTopology Y)
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A]
    (F : Sheaf KY (Type u) ⥤ Sheaf KX (Type u))
    (G : Sheaf KX (Type u) ⥤ Sheaf KY (Type u))
    (adj : F ⊣ G) [PreservesFiniteLimits F]
    (g : RingedPullback.{u, u, u, u, u}
      (diagramConstantRing I Y KY A) (diagramConstantRing I X KX A))
    (hInv : g.uInv = ((diagramSiteSheafEquivalence I Y KY).functor ⋙
      (Functor.whiskeringRight I _ _).obj F) ⋙ (diagramSiteSheafEquivalence I X KX).inverse)
    (hDir : g.uPush = (diagramSiteSheafEquivalence I X KX).functor ⋙
      ((Functor.whiskeringRight I _ _).obj G ⋙ (diagramSiteSheafEquivalence I Y KY).inverse))
    (hAdj : HEq g.adj (((diagramSiteSheafEquivalence I Y KY).toAdjunction.comp
      (adj.whiskerRight I)).comp (diagramSiteSheafEquivalence I X KX).symm.toAdjunction))
    (hConstants : HasCanonicalConstants (diagramSiteTopology I Y KY)
      (diagramSiteTopology I X KX) A g)
    [IsIso g.coefficient]
    (kg : Comparison.{u, u, u, u, u} g)
    (d : CoefficientSquare.{u, u, u, u, u} g) [IsIso d.coefficient']
    (kd : Comparison.{u, u, u, u, u} (changed g d))
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (Modules.{u, u, u} (diagramConstantRing I Y KY A))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (Modules.{u, u, u} (diagramConstantRing I X KX A))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (Modules.{u, u, u} d.R')]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (Modules.{u, u, u} d.S')] :
    Nonempty (Result g kg d kd)
